<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Ruta Sur · Viajes en grupo pequeño por la Patagonia</title>
  
  <!-- GOOGLE FONTS -->
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400&family=Press+Start+2P&family=Special+Elite&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

  <style>
    /* ==========================================================================
       SISTEMA DE DISEÑO & VARIABLES (SEMILLA ruta-24 · CARTEL DE CINE POLACO)
       ========================================================================== */
    :root {
      /* Paleta "Cereza" */
      --bg-main: #fbf1f1;
      --bg-surface: #fefafa;
      --text-main: #2a1215;
      --primary: #b3203a;
      --primary-hover: #8e182d;
      --accent-gold: #b87e44;
      --accent-plum: #5d2a42;
      --border-dark: #2a1215;
      --border-width: 3px;
      
      /* Tipografías */
      --font-heading: 'Press Start 2P', monospace, sans-serif;
      --font-body: 'Barlow', sans-serif;
      --font-accent: 'Special Elite', cursive, monospace;

      /* Radios y Sombras */
      --radius-sm: 4px;
      --radius-pill: 50px;
      --shadow-hard: 5px 5px 0px #2a1215;
      --shadow-hard-lg: 8px 8px 0px #2a1215;
    }

    /* Reset & Base */
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      background-color: var(--bg-main);
      color: var(--text-main);
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    body {
      overflow-x: hidden;
      background-image: radial-gradient(var(--accent-plum) 0.75px, transparent 0.75px);
      background-size: 24px 24px;
      background-position: 0 0;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    /* ACCESIBILIDAD & FOCO */
    :focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid var(--primary);
      outline-offset: 3px;
    }

    .sr-only {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
      white-space: nowrap;
      border: 0;
    }

    /* BOTONES ESTILO POLISH POSTER */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.85rem 1.75rem;
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      border: var(--border-width) solid var(--border-dark);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, background-color 0.2s ease;
      text-align: center;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background-color: var(--primary);
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background-color: var(--primary-hover);
      transform: translate(-2px, -2px);
      box-shadow: 7px 7px 0px #2a1215;
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      background-color: var(--bg-surface);
      color: var(--text-main);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background-color: var(--bg-main);
      transform: translate(-2px, -2px);
      box-shadow: 7px 7px 0px #2a1215;
    }

    /* NAVEGACIÓN HEADER */
    .site-header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background-color: rgba(254, 250, 250, 0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      border-bottom: 4px solid var(--border-dark);
      padding: 0.8rem 1.5rem;
    }

    .nav-container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .brand-logo {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--primary);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      padding: 0.2rem 0;
      border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
      transition: border-color 0.2s;
    }

    .nav-links a:hover {
      border-color: var(--primary);
    }

    /* BORDES Y SECCIONES ALTERNAS */
    section {
      padding: 4rem 1.5rem;
      border-bottom: var(--border-width) solid var(--border-dark);
      position: relative;
    }

    .section-tint {
      background-color: var(--bg-surface);
    }

    .section-dark {
      background-color: var(--accent-plum);
      color: #fefafa;
    }

    .container {
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .section-header {
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .section-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      background-color: var(--accent-gold);
      color: #ffffff;
      padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
      border: 2px solid var(--border-dark);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
      box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px var(--border-dark);
    }

    .section-title {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* PROTOCOLO DE ACTIVOS: LF-PRODUCT SPANS */
    .lf-product {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      vertical-align: middle;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
    }

    .lf-product svg {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
    }

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
       BLOQUE 1: HERO DEL DESTINO (CARTEL POLACO)
       -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    .hero-section {
      padding: 3rem 1.5rem 4rem;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-poster-frame {
      border: 6px solid var(--border-dark);
      background-color: var(--bg-surface);
      padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard-lg);
      border-radius: 4px;
      position: relative;
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 1050px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .hero-badge-top {
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      background-color: var(--primary);
      color: #ffffff;
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 0.4rem 1rem;
      font-size: 1rem;
      border: 2px solid var(--border-dark);
      transform: rotate(-1.5deg);
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px var(--border-dark);
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3.5vw, 2.1rem);
      line-height: 1.4;
      color: var(--text-main);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      max-width: 750px;
      margin: 0 auto 2rem;
      color: var(--text-main);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .hero-illustration-wrapper {
      margin: 2rem auto;
      max-width: 780px;
      border: 3px solid var(--border-dark);
      background-color: var(--bg-main);
      padding: 1rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }

    .hero-illustration-wrapper svg {
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      display: block;
    }

    /* DECORACIONES POLACAS SUELTAS EN HERO */
    .hero-shape {
      position: absolute;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 2;
    }
    .shape-1 {
      top: 20px;
      left: 15px;
      width: 45px;
      height: 45px;
      border: 4px solid var(--primary);
      border-radius: 50%;
      transform: rotate(12deg);
    }
    .shape-2 {
      bottom: 40px;
      right: 25px;
      width: 35px;
      height: 35px;
      background-color: var(--accent-gold);
      border: 3px solid var(--border-dark);
      transform: rotate(45deg);
    }
    .shape-3 {
      top: 50%;
      right: 15px;
      width: 50px;
      height: 50px;
      border: 4px dashed var(--accent-plum);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .hero-cta-box {
      margin-top: 2rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .hero-microcopy {
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--accent-plum);
    }

    /* BENEFICIOS: COLUMNAS REVISTA CON FILETE VERTICAL */
    .hero-benefits-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
      gap: 2rem;
      margin-top: 3.5rem;
      padding-top: 2.5rem;
      border-top: 3px dashed var(--border-dark);
      text-align: left;
    }

    .benefit-col {
      padding-right: 1rem;
      position: relative;
    }

    .benefit-col:not(:last-child)::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      right: 0;
      top: 10%;
      height: 80%;
      width: 2px;
      background-color: var(--accent-gold);
    }

    .benefit-icon {
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .benefit-col h3 {
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      color: var(--primary);
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .benefit-col p {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--text-main);
    }

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
       MARQUESINA PRUEBA SOCIAL (MOVIMIENTO LENTO)
       -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    .marquee-container {
      background-color: var(--accent-plum);
      color: #ffffff;
      border-top: 3px solid var(--border-dark);
      border-bottom: 3px solid var(--border-dark);
      overflow: hidden;
      white-space: nowrap;
      padding: 0.75rem 0;
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .marquee-content {
      display: inline-block;
      animation: marquee 28s linear infinite;
    }

    .marquee-item {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1rem;
      margin-right: 3rem;
    }

    .marquee-bullet {
      color: var(--accent-gold);
    }

    @keyframes marquee {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
       BLOQUE 2: EXPERIENCIAS (TARJETAS TIPO STICKER)
       -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    .experiences-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
      gap: 2rem;
      margin-top: 2rem;
    }

    .sticker-card {
      background-color: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 3px solid var(--border-dark);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      position: relative;
    }

    .sticker-card:nth-child(1) { transform: rotate(-1deg); }
    .sticker-card:nth-child(2) { transform: rotate(1deg); }
    .sticker-card:nth-child(3) { transform: rotate(-0.5deg); }

    .sticker-card:hover {
      transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.02);
      box-shadow: 8px 8px 0px #2a1215;
      z-index: 5;
    }

    .card-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: -12px;
      right: 15px;
      background-color: var(--accent-gold);
      color: #ffffff;
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
      border: 2px solid var(--border-dark);
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .card-svg-header {
      border: 2px solid var(--border-dark);
      background-color: var(--bg-main);
      padding: 0.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      border-radius: 2px;
    }

    .card-title {
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      color: var(--text-main);
    }

    .card-meta {
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--primary);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .card-includes {
      list-style: none;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      flex-grow: 1;
    }

    .card-includes li {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      padding-left: 1.2rem;
      position: relative;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }

    .card-includes li::before {
      content: "✓";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      color: var(--primary);
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    .card-price-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      justify-content: space-between;
      border-top: 2px dashed var(--border-dark);
      padding-top: 1rem;
      margin-top: auto;
    }

    .price-label {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .price-amount {
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
       BLOQUE 3: ITINERARIO (LÍNEA DE TIEMPO CON MAPAS)
       -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    .itinerary-container {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 3rem;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .timeline {
      position: relative;
      padding-left: 2rem;
      border-left: 3px dashed var(--primary);
    }

    .timeline-item {
      position: relative;
      margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
    }

    .timeline-item::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: calc(-2rem - 7px);
      top: 0.3rem;
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      background-color: var(--accent-gold);
      border: 2px solid var(--border-dark);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .day-tag {
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      background-color: var(--accent-plum);
      color: #ffffff;
      padding: 0.1rem 0.5rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      border-radius: 2px;
      display: inline-block;
      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    }

    .day-title {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-main);
    }

    .day-desc {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: #4a282d;
    }

    .itinerary-map-box {
      border: 3px solid var(--border-dark);
      background-color: var(--bg-surface);
      padding: 1rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard);
      position: sticky;
      top: 100px;
    }

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
       BLOQUE 4: GALERÍA (MOSAICO VECTORIAL CON AVIÓN)
       -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    .mosaic-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1rem;
      margin-top: 2rem;
    }

    .mosaic-item {
      border: 3px solid var(--border-dark);
      background-color: var(--bg-surface);
      padding: 0.75rem;
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px var(--border-dark);
      border-radius: 2px;
    }

    .mosaic-item-large {
      grid-column: span 2;
    }

    .mosaic-item-tall {
      grid-row: span 2;
    }

    .mosaic-caption {
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--accent-plum);
    }

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
       BLOQUE 5: VIAJEROS (RESEÑAS / PRUEBA SOCIAL)
       -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    .reviews-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 2rem;
      margin-top: 2rem;
    }

    .review-card {
      background-color: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 3px solid var(--border-dark);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      position: relative;
    }

    .review-stars {
      color: var(--accent-gold);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .review-quote {
      font-style: italic;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .review-author {
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    .review-date {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: #666;
    }

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
       BLOQUE 6: RESERVA (FORMULARIO E INOCULACIÓN DE OBJECIONES)
       -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    .booking-wrapper {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 3rem;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .booking-form-box {
      background-color: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 4px solid var(--border-dark);
      padding: 2rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard-lg);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }

    .form-group {
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    .form-group label {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    .form-control {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 0.75rem;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 1rem;
      border: 2px solid var(--border-dark);
      background-color: var(--bg-main);
      border-radius: 2px;
      color: var(--text-main);
    }

    .form-control:focus {
      outline: none;
      border-color: var(--primary);
      background-color: #ffffff;
    }

    /* INOCULACIÓN DE OBJECIONES EN FAQS ACCORDION */
    .faq-accordion {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .faq-card {
      background-color: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 3px solid var(--border-dark);
      padding: 1.25rem;
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px var(--border-dark);
    }

    .faq-question {
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--primary);
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .faq-answer {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--text-main);
    }

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
       BLOQUE 7: PIE (FOOTER)
       -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    .site-footer {
      background-color: var(--border-dark);
      color: #fbf1f1;
      padding: 3rem 1.5rem;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      border-top: 4px solid var(--accent-gold);
    }

    .footer-grid {
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      gap: 2rem;
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--accent-gold);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .footer-links {
      list-style: none;
    }

    .footer-links li {
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .footer-links a:hover {
      color: var(--accent-gold);
      text-decoration: underline;
    }

    .footer-bottom {
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding-top: 1.5rem;
      border-top: 1px solid #4a282d;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1rem;
      font-family: var(--font-accent);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
    }

    /* RESPONSIVE LAYOUT ADJUSTMENTS */
    @media (max-width: 850px) {
      .itinerary-container,
      .booking-wrapper {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .itinerary-map-box {
        position: relative;
        top: 0;
      }

      .mosaic-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .mosaic-item-large,
      .mosaic-item-tall {
        grid-column: span 1;
        grid-row: span 1;
      }

      .benefit-col:not(:last-child)::after {
        display: none;
      }

      .nav-links {
        display: none; /* Simplificado para dispositivos móviles */
      }
    }

    /* PREFERS REDUCED MOTION */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .marquee-content {
        animation: none;
      }
      .sticker-card, .btn {
        transition: none;
      }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- ==========================================================================
       RESUMEN DEL SISTEMA DE DISEÑO [T1]
       ==========================================================================
       - Semilla: "ruta-24" (Cartel de cine polaco)
       - Paleta "Cereza":
           Fondo principal: #fbf1f1
           Superficie: #fefafa
           Texto principal: #2a1215
           Primario: #b3203a (Rojo gouache)
           Acento 1: #b87e44 (Ocre dorado)
           Acento 2: #5d2a42 (Ciruela profundo)
       - Tipografías:
           Titulares: 'Press Start 2P' (Google Fonts)
           Texto: 'Barlow' (Google Fonts)
           Acento / Cinta / Precios: 'Special Elite' (Google Fonts)
       - Patrón gráfico recurrente:
           1. Bordes oscuros gruesos (#2a1215 de 3px-6px) con sombras proyectadas duras ("sticker style").
           2. Recuadro tipo Cartel Cine Polaco con formas decorativas flotantes (anillo, rombo).
           3. Trazados e ilustraciones con vectores estilo serigrafía gouache y alto contraste.
       ========================================================================== -->

  <!-- ==========================================================================
       MAPA DE NAVEGACIÓN Y BLOQUES [T2]
       ==========================================================================
